heat_pump.notes: ArenaEV lists the Series II (2026-) with Heat pump: Yes; Series II is the MY2027 US car. ArenaEV is a spec database (EU-oriented) and lists the feature as "Yes" without saying standard or optional; read as standard. Rolls-Royce site not usable. ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional (it also says Yes for the 2019–21 i3, where it was a paid option), and its pages mix EU data.
